name: mirage
text: Bids picked off: I read the engine's 117 filled bids (2 days). They are mostly fine: average edge 2.6% when posted, 2.4% at the fill, only 6 of 117 fills ended up below fair. The stop you saw came from one NBA game: three Brooklyn spread lines filled at the same moment when the market moved once, and the guard counted that as 3 of the last 8 fills, which halted bids on every league. The stop now counts games, not fills (one game that moved once is one judgment), so it needs real repeated losses across games to trip. That is v1.0.32, in the release gate now. The pick-offs that do happen are NBA spreads and games within 24 h (fill edge 1.9% vs 2.8% posted); NCAAF, NHL, NFL and team totals hold up at the fill. I did not change the bid rules or the 400% target (you already have 400%, and the sample of bad fills is too small to justify a rule change). The current stop on the engine clears on its own within 3 h. Kalshi: I can't answer that honestly yet, because the Kalshi scan lives on your phone and I can't see its counts from here. I'm adding a funnel to the Kalshi tab (markets read, matched to a game, priced, +EV after fee, listed, plus why matches fail by league) so we can tell matching problems from thin opportunity. Logged as CH55.
